name: Lakeville Thursday Scramble
oneLiner: The Thursday night version of the Monday scramble — two-person, against the field, handicapped, with eight weeks of regular season and two of playoffs. League members take 10% off the menu.
beginnerNote: The friendliest format on the schedule: you both hit, you play the better ball, and the scorecard never records which of you hit the bad one. Handicaps keep the field level.
format: 2-person scramble against the field, handicapped, 18 holes. Format may change based on player feedback.
price: $700 per team. A $50 non-refundable deposit per team holds your spot.
